text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- European Union envoy to the Middle East Moratinous ended his visit to Lebanon, will return for the Baalbek festivals next month.
- Foreign Minister Bouez says two solutions for the question of south Lebanon: U.N. resolution 425 or the peace process.
- Did South Lebanon Army shells accidentally hit the house of a south Lebanon local priest?.
- The occupation breaches the terms of an April 1996 ceasefire understanding by attacking civilians inside and outside the occupation zone.
- French President Chirac urges U.S. President Clinton to lift the U.S. ban on travel to Lebanon.
- Ghosts of a "hunger revolt" hunt Lebanon's top leaders.
- Lebanon complains against Israel at the monitoring committee.
- Israeli air raid into Mleeta in south Lebanon.
